title: withRouteDiscovery
summary: Turn a route resolver into router discovery with shared requests, remembered denials and ordered insertion.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: routeDiscoveryClient builds on this for file routes. Use it directly for manual route arrays: the resolver receives the unmatched URL and returns authorized routes, or none.

sections.title: Behavior
sections.body: Concurrent callers for one path share a request. A path that resolves to no matching route is remembered as denied until router.resetDiscovery(); rejected requests are not remembered. Discovered routes are inserted ahead of less specific patterns, so a public splat cannot shadow them.

sections.title: Route table
sections.body: The router adds discovered routes to the routes array it was given, which its renderers share. Pass an array the application owns; mountApplication and nested routers already do.

sections.title: Builds
sections.body: Vite builds keep router discovery support only with applicationPlugins({ routeDiscovery }); other builds remove it, which keeps routers that never discover at their previous size. Use it without the Vite plugins, or with routeDiscovery configured.
